purpose: Mask-stage gland-object, label, interface, and topology constraints; microscopic gland rendering remains downstream.

constraints.mask_statement: Use native gland instances or an auxiliary gland/lumen map as prohibited/topology regions; reject partial gland cuts, gland split/merge, and lumen filling. If these structures exist only on digest-bound native/auxiliary structure authority, abstain when their protection cannot be rasterized reliably.
required_inputs: native instance mask when supplied by the profile
generation_handoff: Preserve or render continuous gland epithelium and lumina; the semantic mask alone does not guarantee gland morphology.
known_limitations: Semantic connected components may merge touching gland instances.

constraints.mask_statement: Only declared source fine IDs may change; normal epithelium, other differentiation IDs, and every unrequested label remain pixel-identical.
generation_handoff: Render the retained field-derived differentiation context without claiming an unrequested grade change.
known_limitations: GLaS fine IDs are field-derived rather than per-gland expert grades.

constraints.mask_statement: Generate candidates only from an existing directed interface, keep them within the allowed band, and reject a short/deep notch or detached changed component.
generation_handoff: Use H&E to ensure the selected non-gland band is true compatible tissue rather than lumen, mucin, debris, or muscle.
known_limitations: Geometric interface validity cannot identify non-gland histology after a coarse remap.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not use morphology to fill holes, join glands, create tumor islands, split the source component, or merge target components.
known_limitations: A hole count is not sufficient to distinguish lumen, mucin, necrosis, or annotation artifact.
